item.title: Welcome: Fiona Mendes, Project Elevate Program Director
item.description: Fiona started on Thursday 24 September and will lead Project Elevate, spending the next few weeks getting up to speed. Welcome to the team, Fiona.

item.title: AFL Grand Final: Brisbane Stun Fremantle Late
item.description: Fremantle led by 17 points in the last quarter before Brisbane kicked four goals in the final four minutes to win. Kylie Minogue opened the day in front of 100,000+ at the MCG.

item.title: September Town Hall - Wed 30 Sep
item.description: Hosted by Catryn Tuckwell, Chief Legal & Compliance Officer. Submit questions via Menti or on the day. All questions remain anonymous. Leaders, send through any updates to share.

item.title: Trivia Night Winners: Statuhairy Interest
item.description: Last week's Trivia Night was a great success. Congratulations to team Statuhairy Interest on the win. Photos and videos are in the Events channel of the All Staff team.

item.title: Board Meeting - Thu 1 Oct
item.description: The LeavePlus Board meets on Thursday 1 October.

item.title: 50th Anniversary Celebration - Thu 1 Oct, L5 Breakout
item.description: About 100 guests join us from 5.30pm to celebrate 50 years supporting building and construction. Please avoid the L5 breakout space from 3pm and use another kitchen for tea and coffee.

item.title: Final Reminder: Register Your Microsoft Passkey by Fri 2 Oct
item.description: LeavePlus is turning on Microsoft passkeys across Microsoft 365. Sign in with your face, fingerprint or device PIN instead of a password and a code. Full details on CoINVEST News.

item.title: Habitat for Humanity Volunteer Day - Thu 15 October
item.description: The final volunteer day for 2026 is Thursday 15 October. Open to full-time and fixed-term employees. Please consider volunteering for this worthy cause.

item.title: EOI: Acknowledgement of Country at Town Hall
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Let Matt Young know or sign up via the EOI form on Teams.

item.description: With your manager's agreement, you can purchase between 1 and 4 additional weeks of annual leave over a 12-month period.

item.description: Missed a Town Hall? All presentations are available on The Hub.

item.title: Looking for a New Role? Check Team Tailor
item.description: Current vacancy: Paralegal (3B), 6-month maximum term contract. Apply on Team Tailor with your LeavePlus email, not SEEK or other sites, so internal applicants are tracked.

item.title: Seen a Colleague Living Our Values? LOVE Awards
item.description: Nominate a colleague for a LOVE Award. Past winners are listed in the Hall of Fame on the CoINVEST News site.
